{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Kun as Earth|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Kun as Earth|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Kun as Earth|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

revision.text:
{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Kun as Earth|ja|坤|1=Kun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Kun as Earth|ja|坤|1=kūn|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kun (Bagua)|lt=Kun為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q598015}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|ja|坤為地|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun as Earth|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun (Bagua)|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q598015}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt\=Gen (☶)|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Kun corresponds to the area between {{ill|Wei (Earthly Branch)|ja|未|1=wèi|lt=Goat (未)|2=ja|3=未|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q20128396}} and [[:en:Monkey (zodiac)|Monkey (申)]], known as *Hitsujisaru* (ひつじさる).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Kun corresponds to the area between {{ill|Wei (Earthly Branch)|ja|未|1=wèi|lt=Goat (未)|2=ja|3=未|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q20128396}} and [[:en:Monkey (zodiac)|Monkey (申)]], known as *Hitsujisaru* (ひつじさる).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Kun corresponds to the area between {{ill|Wei (Earthly Branch)|ja|未|1=wèi|lt=Goat (未)|2=ja|3=未|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wei (Earthly Branch)|13=User:Immanuelle/Goat (Zodiac)|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q20128396}} and [[:en:Monkey (zodiac)|Monkey (申)]], known as *Hitsujisaru* (ひつじさる).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh_min_nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh_yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh-min-nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh_yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh-min-nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh-yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh-min-nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh-yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh-min-nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh-yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|qq=|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☷]][[fr:Kūn (symbole asiatique)]][[ja:坤]][[ko:곤 (괘)]][[nl:Aarde (trigram)]][[pt:Kūn (I Ching)]][[zh-min-nan:Khun-kòa]][[zh-yue:坤卦]][[zh:坤卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q598015]] Wikidata name: kūn [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 07:44, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Kun''' (坤) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☷'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yin (⚋) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{nihongo|Kun as Earth|坤為地}}, consisting of Kun below and Kun above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Kun symbolizes earth, compliance, cattle, the abdomen, the mother, grandmother, feminine virtues, the stomach, the right shoulder, support roles, sluggishness, the masses, and hesitation. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Kun is associated with {{ill|Yi (Heavenly Stem)|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yi (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoto (乙)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Gui (Heavenly Stem)|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoto (癸)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]].
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Kun corresponds to the {{ill|southwest|ja|西南|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/southwest|1=southwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q11627311}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|Kan=c|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn == Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Kun is the eighth in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:North|north]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yin.
